title: KnowledgeClock
description: A client-side Fabric mod that tracks Knowledge cooldowns for skill progression on servers using a Knowledge-based system. Only functional with my Knowledgebound mod
body: A client-side Fabric mod designed to track individual Knowledge timers, ensuring you always know how long you are locked out of gaining experience or progression in specific skills. This mod is intended exclusively for use on a custom server that makes use of the [Knowledgebound](https://modrinth.com/mod/knowledgebound) progression system. It has no functionality or purpose on standard Minecraft worlds.
